about: Cignetti-era Indiana starting quarterbacks, one per season. The newest season is the current QB; every earlier season is a comparison QB. To start a new season, add one entry (key, name, short, season, espn_id) and the pipeline backfills or tracks everything else. final_totals are the published season totals (passing yards, TD, INT) the stored game log must reconcile to; add them when a season ends.

qbs.name: Kurtis Rourke
qbs.note: led Indiana to its first College Football Playoff

qbs.name: Fernando Mendoza
qbs.note: won the Heisman and the national title
